items.headline: AI stocks rebound in a shortened Black Friday session; S&P 500 posts its best week in over a year
items.note: Stocks rose Friday in a session that ended at 1 p.m. ET. Reports differ on the exact day's moves (S&P 500 up roughly 1–1.6%, Nasdaq up roughly 1.7–2.3%), so treat them as approximate. One report put the S&P 500's weekly gain at 5.6%, its best since April 2025, after a rough month for tech.

items.headline: Nvidia dips sharply, then ends Friday slightly higher
items.note: Reports say Nvidia fell nearly 3% at one point before closing up under 1%. The stock has been the swing factor in the AI trade since Jensen Huang's return as CEO, so chip moves set the tone for tech hiring sentiment.

items.headline: Anthropic shares climb back above the $83 IPO price
items.note: Forbes reported AI shares, including Anthropic, rallying in premarket trading, and other reports said Anthropic rose 8–11% on the day (one cited about $91.88). The stock had dipped below its offering price earlier in the week.

items.headline: Economists still see a December Fed rate hike as the base case
items.note: Oxford Economics says broadening price pressures make a 25 basis point hike in December its base case. Higher rates raise borrowing costs and tend to weigh on tech stocks. I couldn't confirm newer odds today.

items.headline: Tech job postings are up 18.5% from a year ago, but hiring is still modest
items.note: A summary of CompTIA's report says tech employment grew by about 7,200 jobs in October and active tech postings reached 629,876. Layoffs.fyi counted over 142,000 tech layoffs at 350 companies in 2026 as of Nov 11. Postings are growing but competition for entry-level roles stays tough.

items.headline: OpenAI's GPT-5 API shuts down Dec 11, with gpt-5.6-sol as the replacement
items.note: If you've built projects on GPT-5 or o3 snapshots, plan to migrate. Third-party trackers list the date; check OpenAI's deprecation page to confirm.

items.headline: Anthropic says it moved its Messages API from Python to Rust, with Claude doing most of the work
items.note: One AI digest cites an Anthropic engineering post from Nov 25. It's a sign of AI-assisted coding being used on production systems, which is relevant to how ML engineering work is changing. I only saw this in a digest, not the original post.

items.headline: NYC fintech Imprint raises $130M; AI startup Hatz AI raises $24M
items.note: AlleyWatch's latest weekly roundup I could find (Nov 8–14) lists these rounds. NYC's fintech and AI startups are a good target list for internships.

learn.explain: Trading volume is how many shares change hands in a period. High volume means lots of buyers and sellers agree on a price, so a move is more trustworthy. On days like the half-day after Thanksgiving, many traders are away, so volume is low and a few big orders can push prices around more than usual. That's why a big jump in a shortened session, like Friday's AI rebound, is worth watching but not over-reading.
learn.try: Look up the volume of SPY on a normal day versus last Friday and compare.
